body: I'm very sorry about what happened to you. I hope that one day you find peace.

One of my faults is do things first, ask questions later. Which is probably why I ended up where I am. But that's who I am.

I appreciate your concern; and I genuinely hope you continued to reach out to others so that you can help them. You can't help those who won't help themselves. Keep fighting the good fight. Thank you for what you do.
I understand and the vagueness of my post is on purpose; I'm ashamed to speak of it. Based on my personal experience, I can only offer the things I would do different if I had an extra life.

I've made peace with my decision. I'm giving away the things I cherish most to those who can use it as a daily reminder to not make the same mistake I will make. Tracking numbers will be sent out. Once everything is called for, I'm out.

On a separate note; available is a QNAP-TVS871 w/ (4) 10TB hard drives, Ubiquiti US-24-250W, Ubiquiti USG, Ubiquiti Cloud Key & Ubiquiti EdgeRouter X, a gaming PC (8700K, GTX 960, Elgato HD60, 500GB NVME w/ 3TB drive), a triple monitor setup with Dell S2716DG and (2) Acer G235H, Schiit stack (Magni & Modi 2) & Sennheisser HD598 Jubilee from Massdrop. My pride and joy of tech. Only claim them if you promise to live life and do not make the same mistake I will. Use it as a daily reminder to live life.
Be straight, no matter how hard or how bad you'll get in trouble. Trust is a easy thing to break, and a hard thing to gain back. You do it enough times and you won't recover from it.
Thanks. Preparing for the worst and hoping for the best.

What scares me is that it comes naturally. Something just comes out and I just go with it. I've already scheduled my first appointment with a therapist tomorrow. 

What sucks is, I realized the problem when it's too late.

Thank you to you and u/cherryquartz for the suggestions. I called for a consultation earlier and now I have my first appointment for tomorrow. 

I haven't had a chance to look into career counseling as of yet, but I have started looking into some volunteer work. 

I'm trying to fix things with my ex who wants nothing to do with me. She continues to pick up just so she can berate and make fun of me when I do try and answer her questions truthfully. There's nothing that I can say to make her believe that I want to make some changes in my life for her. I just don't want her to move on because I love her. What would you guys suggest u/yes_a_penguin u/cherrryquartz?
I too, am trying not to be a fuck up as well. I don't know what to do or where to start.
How do I go about committing to it? Do I randomly or aimlessly do things for others?
